In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
SimStudio is a MDE-based software environment, for the modeling, simulation and collaboration around models of complex systems.
SimStudio is a MDE platform that supports the development of DEVS models, and that provides a set of services to support their execution, analysis, and transformation.

SimStudio is a modeling and simulation environment that allows the user to create, edit, execute and analyze models in the DEVS formalisms, and to transform them into other formalisms, such as Petri Nets or UML.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are developing a MDE-based simulation environment.
we are proposing a Model-Driven Simulation Environment.

we are building a platform that is based on the DEVs formalism and the DEVS unified language, and that is able to support the modeling and simulation of complex systems, as well as the analysis of the models.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the DEVS formal framework, which is a well-established simulation formalism, can be used as a basis for the development of MDE tools.
MDE is not only a software engineering paradigm, but also a simulation paradigm.
we propose to use MDE as the basis for a software environment for modeling and simulation, in order to provide a unified and coherent platform for modeling, simulation analysis and code generation.
